scientific_question: Why does a stable rank-480 atlas retain about 72% of the dense input-Jacobian row energy and 92% of routed output, yet a realizable ridge expert retains only about 20% of analytic input JVP?

theory.identity: For p=Wfc x, t=Wfc d, p_hat=Wfc_hat x, and t_hat=Wfc_hat d, the dense and realizable expert tangents are Jd=Wproj[gelu'(p) elementwise t] and J_hat d=Wproj[gelu'(p_hat) elementwise t_hat].
theory.teacher_gate_projected_normal: Wproj[gelu'(p) elementwise t_hat] freezes the dense activation boundaries and tests only whether the atlas-constrained normal directions carry the tangent.
theory.projected_gate_dense_normal: Wproj[gelu'(p_hat) elementwise t] keeps the dense directional derivative but moves the activation boundaries to the fitted expert; it isolates gate/phase displacement.
theory.self_consistent: Wproj[gelu'(p_hat) elementwise t_hat] is the actual realizable ridge tangent already known to fail.
theory.first_order_decomposition: For delta_p=p_hat-p and delta_t=t_hat-t, J_hat d-Jd is approximated by Wproj[gelu'(p) elementwise delta_t + gelu''(p) elementwise delta_p elementwise t]. The first term is normal-direction error and the second is activation-boundary error. Residual beyond their sum measures higher-order gate interaction.
theory.structural_consequence: A compact parameter generator may materialize a full-rank 768-dimensional c_fc even when its trainable parameter manifold is low-dimensional. The rejected S U chart instead imposed rank(c_fc)<=480. If projected normals fail even under teacher gates, the next family must restore full input rank. If teacher-gated normals pass but moved gates fail, the next family must preserve or explicitly fit activation-boundary phase. If each counterfactual passes alone but the self-consistent tangent fails, the binding error is their nonlinear interaction and requires joint boundary-aware functional fitting.
theory.not_a_fit_or_candidate: This audit recomputes the already registered ridge coefficients and evaluates frozen algebraic counterfactuals. It has no optimizer, checkpoint update, parameter candidate, rank sweep, or LM loss.

data_protocol.sampling: Recompute the predecessor's exact terminal top-2 routed expert samples and frozen ridge coefficients independently for discovery A, discovery B, and heldout; score all counterfactuals on untouched full heldout activations with fixed routing and probabilities.

coefficient_replay.formula: With the sealed split basis U and Z=X U^T, solve A=(Z^T Z + lambda I)^(-1) Z^T(X Wfc^T), Wfc_hat=A^T U.

decomposition_protocol.gelu_second_derivative: Differentiate the exact-erf GELU derivative analytically in float32 and verify against a central finite difference before execution.
decomposition_protocol.routed_scoring: For every arm, use exact terminal top-2 router selections and frozen mixture probabilities, then report mean heldout tangent recovery, every-layer recovery, minimum expert recovery, and two-bank action agreement.
decomposition_protocol.error_accounting: Report normal-term energy, boundary-term energy, their cosine, each term's cosine with the exact self-minus-dense tangent error, the fraction of exact error energy recovered by their sum, and the higher-order residual energy fraction.
decomposition_protocol.precision: float32 action/JVP evaluation and float64 scalar accumulation
decomposition_protocol.selection: No threshold, bank, layer, expert, rank, ridge, probe, or checkpoint may be selected from the observed decomposition.

decision_rule.normal_capacity_binding: If teacher-gated projected normals fail in either causal bank, restore full input rank in the next theoretical family. Do not attempt boundary loss or another rank-480 coefficient fit first.
decision_rule.boundary_phase_binding: If teacher-gated projected normals pass but projected-gate dense normals fail, preregister a full-rank compact generator whose primary constraint/loss preserves pre-GELU phase and derivative gates; do not use preactivation MSE alone.
decision_rule.nonlinear_interaction_binding: If both isolated counterfactuals pass but the self-consistent tangent fails, require a joint output-plus-exact-JVP coefficient oracle before designing a compact generator. A diagonal or separately fitted correction is not authorized.
decision_rule.higher_order_binding: If the frozen first-order normal-plus-boundary expansion recovers less than 0.8 of exact tangent-error energy, treat local linear boundary penalties as insufficient and require direct exact-JVP fitting in the next oracle.
decision_rule.unexpected_self_pass: If the replayed self-consistent tangent clears 0.6, stop because it contradicts the sealed predecessor; diagnose identity or scoring drift before further work.

systems.performance_gate: Run committed-source analytic-derivative, replay, and reduced-shape tests. Foreground-poll only if the exact audit projects to <=5 minutes; otherwise attach one verified terminal/error @Codex watcher immediately.
systems.callback_policy: Terminal success and actionable failure only for a one-to-two-hour run; no milestone callbacks.
